messages:
maria: heads-up — quickstart JS sample app is producing intermittent 429s in our onboarding perf runs. server-side quotas don't show sustained overage.
aj: can you paste the sample client config?
maria: snippet below (trimmed):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  maxInflightRequests: 20,
  prefetchPages: 3,
  pageSize: 40,
  retry: { maxRetries: 2 }
});
```
sam: oof. 20 inflight + 3 prefetch == spikes of ~23 concurrent calls per session. with token-based qps that's enough to trip short bursts.
kim: python quickstart uses max_inflight=6 by default. seems we accidentally shipped different calming defaults across sdks.
ryan: do we have traces to show the burst pattern?
maria: yes, pasted condensed trace: "2026-03-20T10:11:05Z start id=xyz inflight=22" then several 429 quota_exceeded within ~150ms.
aj: immediate mitigation: change quickstart JS example to conservative defaults (e.g., maxInflightRequests=6, prefetchPages=0) and add an in-process leaky-bucket gate.
sam: agreed. we should also add an opt-in aggressive mode flag in SDKs instead of risky defaults.
kim: i'll draft a parity PR to align defaults across JS/Python/Go, and include a changelog callout.
ryan: ops suggestion — add an X-Client-Wind window header so we can correlate bursts in access logs.
dev-bot: created issue #812: "quickstart: reduce js inflight defaults & add inflight telemetry"
ops-bot: note: support can temporarily raise per-account burst allowance, but that increases tail cost. better to fix defaults.
maria: I'll update the sample repo README + quickstart snippet. Also adding a troubleshooting blurb: "If you see onboarding 429s reduce maxInflightRequests and prefetchPages; enable jittered exponential backoff; check Console quota usage."
aj: adding a tiny retry example to quickstart showing randomized backoff.
kim: can we also add a tiny SDK hook that emits current inflight count to console so developers see burstiness locally?
sam: yes, and add a small telemetry metric name `client.inflight.current` so Console can surface spikes.
maria: perfect. i'll send the patch and tag @support-runbook for the one-liner. thanks all. :rocket:
